evals.name: review-request-invokes-review
evals.prompt: Can you review the changes on this branch before I open a PR?
evals.expected_output: do-code-review is invoked and analyses the diff

assertions.text: Findings reference specific files and lines

evals.name: dispatches-to-language-checker
evals.expected_output: The Python language checker is used rather than generic prose review

assertions.text: Review applies Python-specific criteria, not generic advice
Findings are concrete and actionable rather than stylistic platitudes

evals.name: prose-review-uses-content-type-path
evals.expected_output: The markdown content-type reviewer is used, not a language checker

assertions.text: Review treats the target as prose, not code
